cyber_security_mandates.baseline_standard_ref: CEN/CENELEC Harmonized Standards under CRA / IEC 62443-4-1 / IEC 62443-4-2 / ETSI EN 303 645
cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: Important Class I (Module B+C or Harmonized Standard self-assessment); Important Class II (Mandatory Module B+C or Module H CAB examination); Critical (European Cybersecurity Certificate)
cyber_security_mandates.details: Under CRA Annex I, products with digital elements must be delivered without known exploitable vulnerabilities, with automatic security updates enabled by default, zero hardcoded universal credentials, and machine-readable SBOM/CBOM. Article 14 requires 24h notification of active exploitation.

cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: National Critical Infrastructure Audits; Mandatory Security Assessment by accredited CAB every 24 months under NIS2
cyber_security_mandates.details: NIS2 Article 21 mandates risk management policies, supply chain security audits, zero-trust network segregation, and business continuity management for essential and important entities.

data_privacy_sovereignty.supervisory_dpa: National Data Protection Authority of Finland
data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: No general localization within EU/EEA. Transfers outside EEA strictly conditional under Chapter V.
data_privacy_sovereignty.cross_border_transfer_mechanism: Adequacy Decisions (Art 45), Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs, Art 46), Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs, Art 47), Derogations (Art 49)

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: EU Dual-Use Regulation (EU) 2021/821 Annex I Category 5 Part 2 (Information Security). Wassenaar Arrangement member.
cryptography_controls.approved_encryption_standards: AES-256, RSA >= 3072, ECC (NIST P-256/P-384, Ed25519), BSI TR-02102-1, SOG-IS Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: BSI Technical Guideline TR-02102-1 and ANSSI PQC migration recommendation: hybrid post-quantum key encapsulation (ML-KEM / Kyber) required for long-term secure communications by 2026-2030.
cryptography_controls.regulatory_agency: Ministry of Telecommunications & Trade of Finland

incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Article 14(1) CRA: Any actively exploited vulnerability in a product with digital elements placed on the single market.

incident_disclosure_rules.breach_type: Significant Incident in Critical Infrastructure / Essential Entity
recipient_authorities: National Computer Emergency Response Team of Finland (FI-CERT)
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Article 23 NIS2: Any incident causing severe operational disruption or material financial/physical damage to third parties.

recipient_authorities: National Data Protection Authority of Finland
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Article 33 GDPR: Breach of security leading to accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, or unauthorized disclosure of personal data.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
